reference: AN2019_016_v9 section 4.2; Run-3 ID-only tag-and-probe revision with explicit Ele8 tag plateau

campaign_inputs.run2024i_policy: Use the standard MINIv6NANOv15 production and the audited permanent-skip policy; do not reintroduce duplicated Run2024I MINIv6NANOv15_v2 files.
campaign_inputs.mc_campaign_note: Use the single Summer24 SPS-JpsiJpsiToMuMuEE sample for the nominal electron signal template.

binning_policy: Count and fit an initial 4x5 grid. Any later merging must be an exact post-reduction sum justified by fit stability; NanoAOD files must not be reread for alternative coarser candidates.
eta_policy: Exclude the 1.4442--1.566 ECAL transition; the first endcap interval is populated only for abs(eta)>1.566.
target_selection: cutBased >= 1; miniPFRelIso_all is not part of the probe pass/fail definition
denominator: reconstructed GSF electron with 5 < pT < 10 GeV passing the ECAL fiducial region, conversion veto, and lostHits <= 1, without a cutBased or mini-isolation requirement
tag: tight high-purity electron with pT > 10 GeV and miniPFRelIso_all < 0.1 matched to an Ele8+PFJet30 reference-trigger object
trigger_object_bit_source: CMSSW_15_0_X PhysicsTools/NanoAOD triggerObjects_cff.py electron quality bit 13: HLT_Ele*PFJet*
reference_trigger_strategy: The pT>10 GeV trigger-matched tag supplies the Ele8 leg. PFJet30 is the event-side leg. The 5--10 GeV probe is not trigger matched and is not required to be isolated.
adoption_gates: probe pass/fail audit proves mini-isolation is absent from the numerator
tag pT > 10 GeV and Ele8 trigger-object matching are present in every adopted shard
5--6 and 6--7 GeV probe bins have statistically usable pass and fail samples
simultaneous pass/fail fit convergence in every adopted bin
bin-by-bin scale-factor stability under fit-model, fit-window, binning, and pileup variations
